title: The Splendid harvest of that year
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：splendid　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 splendid 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the tailor wrote of ① a splendid harvest of that year in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so splendid that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the splendid ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the splendid harvest of that year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too splendid to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the splendid ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a splendid view from the tower, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as splendid as the view from the tower they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was splendid or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something splendid, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite splendid; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the splendid ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, year after year, she wrote of another splendid harvest of that year in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less splendid than anybody had expected. ⑩ The splendid view from the tower that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the splendid ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 极好（前置定语 a splendid harvest of that year：1983 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件极好的收成）
B. adj. 极好／壮丽（两处加强说法：so splendid that … 与 no less splendid than …）
C. adj. 极好／壮丽（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 极好（表语 too splendid to do：母亲觉得它太极好，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 壮丽（前置定语 a splendid view from the tower：叔叔把整件事称作一桩壮丽的景色）
F. adj. 壮丽（同级比较 as splendid as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩塔上壮丽的景色相比）
G. adj. 壮丽（后置定语 something splendid：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 壮丽（受程度副词修饰 quite splendid：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a splendid harvest of that year
the splendid harvest of that year that
a splendid view from the tower
The splendid view from the tower that

answers.why: splendid 意为“极好”，1983 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件极好的收成”，此处作前置定语 a splendid harvest of that year。
splendid 意为“极好”，此处用 so splendid that 结构，说它极好到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
splendid 意为“极好”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的极好那年极好的收成，等于最高级的说法。
splendid 意为“极好”，母亲认为这件东西“太极好了，谁也用不上”，too splendid to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩壮丽的景色”，此处作前置定语 a splendid view from the tower。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩塔上壮丽的景色一样壮丽”，同级比较用 as splendid as。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“壮丽的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something splendid。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当壮丽”，quite 修饰原级 splendid。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，no less splendid than 表示“其壮丽不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之壮丽不亚于任何人的预料。
splendid 意为“壮丽”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的壮丽景色”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件极好的收成。（a splendid harvest of that year）
它极好到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so splendid that …）
母亲觉得它太极好，谁也用不上。（too splendid to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩壮丽的景色。（a splendid view from the tower）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩塔上壮丽的景色一样壮丽。（as splendid as …）
到了 1990 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件壮丽的东西。（something splendid）
answers: In 1983 the tailor wrote of a splendid harvest of that year in the order.
It was so splendid that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too splendid to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a splendid view from the tower.
He said nobody would call it as splendid as the view from the tower they had once had.
By 1990 the order asked for nothing but something splendid.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 splendid 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the tailor wrote of a splendid harvest of that year in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the splendid harvest of that year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too splendid to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a splendid view from the tower, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite splendid, and everybody laughed.
The splendid ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
